name: Junior Software Engineer AI Project Operating System

sections.02-checklists: Definition of done, Spec Kit, security, testing, deployment, and documentation checklists.
sections.03-templates: Reusable files to copy into each new project, including Spec Kit templates.
sections.04-prompt-library: Prompts for ChatGPT, Claude, Spec Kit, Cursor, CodeRabbit, and TestSprite workflows.
sections.05-examples: Example project and Spec Kit feature workflows.
sections..github: Issue and pull request templates for professional GitHub workflow.
